commands.javascript: node --check js/app.js && node --check js/sculpture.js && node --check js/i18n.js

notes: Marketing site: no application CRUD contracts apply.
Native select popup geometry is intentionally platform-owned.
app.js owns validation and sets noValidate only when JavaScript is available, preserving no-JS native validation.
External addEventListener handlers and shared CSS textarea rules are not resolved by the literal-tag auditor. See QA.md for runtime verification.
The site-wide language selector uses native Select ownership; catalogs cover all eleven public pages and retain form field values and endpoints.
